name: E2E Portal Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup-node:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

  install-dependencies:
    needs: setup-node
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install
          pnpm add --save-dev @playwright/test playwright

  run-e2e-tests:
    needs: install-dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: pnpm test:e2e

  verify-traffic:
    needs: run-e2e-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify traffic
        run: ./scripts/verify_traffic.sh

  setup-socks5-udp:
    needs: run-e2e-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Setup SOCKS5 UDP
        run: |
          cd imix_connect
          cargo build --release
          ./target/release/imix_connect --socks5-udp

  report-results:
    needs: [run-e2e-tests, verify-traffic, setup-socks5-udp]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Upload test artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: test-results/
      - name: Report test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: "E2E Tests"
          path: test-results/
          reporter: "jest"

  codecov:
    needs: run-e2e-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: target/debug/deps/*.cov
          directory: target/debug/deps
          fail_ci_if_error: true

jobs:

        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

  install-dependencies:

    steps:

        run: |
